The '''Lavisar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]] launched a raid into the planet which culminated into the [[Battle of Lavisar]].<ref name="if" />
